Rhea Malhotra: Nimbus pilot update  Legal just replied: they need a written data-deletion SLA and an auditable proof-of-deletion flow before signing off. They also asked if we can auto-delete logs on demand. Can we confirm options before enablement? :alert:
Liam Baxter: We support deletion-by-request today via the control plane but proof-of-deletion is manual (export + hash). Engineering can add a signed deletion receipt but it'll be a small feature. ETA estimate 5 business days if prioritized.
Noemi Alvarez: Procurement flagged retention windows in the contract: they want default 7d for pilot telemetry. Can we offer 7d auto-retain with immediate deletion on request for Nimbus?
Kenji Sato: Tech notes: we have tenant-level retention and a "delete-job" endpoint. Suggested API for on-demand deletion:
```
POST https://api.redwood/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/data-deletion
{
  "requester": "nimbus-legal@company.com",
  "scope": "logs,telemetry,kvcache",
  "retain_for_days": 0
}
```
Response includes job_id which we can sign with a deletion receipt. Need infra approval to enable auto-receipts.
Rhea Malhotra: Good. Can Kenji draft the receipt format and we can send it to Nimbus legal? If they require signed KMS-backed receipts we may need a rapid compliance ticket. Tag renewal-risk if legal says "no".
Liam Baxter: I'll ask infra for temporary KMS signing (fecility key) and check if we can produce receipts signed by our HSM. ETA 48h for preliminary answer.
Noemi Alvarez: Also asked for a checkbox on the enablement invite: "Request deletion proof" so legal gets the right workflow. I'll add it to the invite if we can deliver.
pilot-ops-bot: Reminder: Nimbus enablement scheduled by Rhea Malhotra on 2026-03-30T16:00:00Z. Use /pilot-survey to attach the post-session 4Q micro-survey.
Kenji Sato: Draft deletion receipt sample below:
```
{
  "job_id": "del-8f7a2",
  "tenant_id": "nimbus-557",
  "deleted_scopes": ["logs","telemetry"],
  "deleted_at": "2026-03-30T16:45:00Z",
  "signature": "MEUCIQ..."
}
```
Note: signature placeholder; needs KMS flow.
Rhea Malhotra: Thanks Kenji. Action items: 1) Liam  request KMS signing access & confirm feasibility, 2) Kenji  finalize receipt schema and small runbook for legal, 3) Noemi  add "Request deletion proof" flag to invite & confirm 7d default retention in contract. I'll add renewal-risk if legal rejects auto-proof.
Noemi Alvarez: I'll also put a short procurement note in the invite: "We will provide deletion proof within 5 business days after request (subject to HSM provisioning)" so they see a timeline.
Liam Baxter: Infra responded: temporary signing can be enabled via emergency KMS key, requires SOC checklist. I'll kick off the checklist now and DM updates.
Kenji Sato: If we can't enable signed receipts in time, fallback = manual deletion + CSV export of deleted keys + timestamped note from CS. We'll mark that as "non-ideal" in the runbook.
Rhea Malhotra: For feedback capture, we'll run a 4-question micro-survey after the enablement (usefulness 1-5, any compliance blockers y/n+text, request deletion proof y/n, request follow-up y/n). If compliance blockers flagged, auto-create a CS escalation and set pilot board tag = "renewal-risk:high".
Noemi Alvarez: Enablement invite scheduled for Tue 2026-03-31 09:00 PT (60m). Included pre-read + compliance appendix.
pilot-ops-bot: Hook ready: https://hooks.internal/pilot-feedback/nimbus-deletion. Use /pilot-survey to attach the questions.
Kenji Sato: I'll upload the receipt schema & sample runbook to the drive: https://redwood.app/drive/pilots/nimbus/compliance-runbook v1.
Liam Baxter: KMS checklist started; SOC team expects 3 business days. I'll update thread when signing is green.
Rhea Malhotra: Great. We'll proceed with enablement but add a note to the pilot board about compliance gating. If Nimbus legal accepts the planned timeline, we keep "renewal-risk:low"; if they push back, escalate to "renewal-risk:high". Thanks team :white_check_mark:
Kenji Sato: Will monitor post-survey responses and open CS ticket automatically on compliance blocker.
pilot-ops-bot: Thread will auto-archive to pilot-nimbus after 72h of inactivity.
